question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded composer modal to the Control UI, or solve long-prompt friction through inline growth, resizing, and send-shortcut preferences instead?
rationale: This adds new user-facing composer semantics rather than fixing a broken existing contract, and the related open PRs only cover shortcut preferences.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Design and implement an explicit expanded editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer Ergonomics
options.body: Use auto-grow, resizing, and the send-shortcut path to improve long prompts without adding a modal editing mode.

options.title: Decline This UX Direction
options.body: Close the issue by maintainer decision if the core composer should stay lean and modal composition should not be added.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Design and implement an explicit expanded editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest observed combination of prior issue review and recent current-main Control UI chat/composer history.
